overview: This Senate resolution orders a revised edition of the Senate Manual to be prepared and printed for the 119th Congress. The Senate Manual is a reference book that contains the Senate's standing rules, orders, key laws and other documents senators and staff use in their work. The resolution directs the Senate Committee on Rules and Administration to prepare it and authorizes 1,200 additional bound copies for the Senate's use. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on July 31, 2025.
for: Supporters say an updated manual gives senators and staff an accurate, current reference to the rules and procedures that govern their work.
against: Critics say printing 1,200 bound copies is a routine cost that could be reduced by relying more on digital versions.
